question: Indira Bora, an internationally acclaimed dancer was awarded Padma Shri in 2020. She is renowned for her contribution to which of the following dance forms?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sattriya**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sattriya**

 
 
• **In 2020, the renowned dancer Indira Bora received the Padma Shri honour.** She is renowned for her contribution to Sattriya dance form.
 
• A notable form of Indian classical dance is **sattriya**. This dance was first developed as a component of **Bhaona, which are performances of Ankiya Nat**, one-act dramas that were originally produced by **Sankardev, the Assamese polymath **who lived in the 15th and 16th centuries.
 
• **Themes from the epics (Mahabharata and Ramayana) **are also included, along with references to **Lord Krishna and other Vishnu avatars like Rama and Sita**.
 
• Radha does not appear in Sattriya dance performances because Radha is not a part of the **Mahapurush Srimanta Sankaradeva's philosophic religion**, which is founded on** Vedanta, the Bhagavad Gita, and the Bhagavata Purana.** 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indira** **Bose**

 
 
• **One of the 15 illustrious individuals from the Northeast to receive the prized Padma award is Indira Bora from Assam. **

 
 
• **In 1996, she received the Sangeet Natak Akademi award for Sattriya dance.**
 
 
 
• The dance form's foremost pioneer, Bora, made significant contributions to art.
 
• In addition, she choreographed some poetry and songs by notable poets and artists, including **Rabindra Nath Tagore, Bhupen Hazarika, Jyotiprasad Agarwala, Bishnu Rabha, and others.**
 
• She was chosen by the **Kerala government for the "Guru Gopinath Desiya Natya Puraskaram, 2019"** (the highest honour given by the State government every year for excellence in dance), in recognition of her contribution to popularising Sattriya dance.
